acceptedClaim: The specified passive lumped RLC circuit has capacitor voltage gain2 at resonance, positive source-off load work from initial storage, and a closed signed energy budget. Reactive apparent power is not mean real power.
independentMethod: Independent exact matrix-eigenfunction solution for q,I and Simpson sampled-power integration; analytic source-off resistor partition and complex phasors. Producer numerical solver was not imported.
limitations: A finite lumped linear simulation is not hardware calibration, empirical overunity testing or a proof about every electrical device.
Source off means ideal source voltage set to zero while the series loop remains closed; opening a physical switch would change this model.
Source waveform is sine starting at zero, stated explicitly in producer report.
Inductance/capacitance are constant here; moving geometry would add mechanical work and require a different boundary.
Numerical closure tolerance is not measurement uncertainty.

sourceChecks.supports: Inductor energy, mutual energy and source-work requirements when geometry changes.
Linear ideal impedance assumptions and power supplied by external sources.

nextQuestion: For a prescribed moving-inductance geometry at fixed current, does including electrical source work, resistive heat, field energy and mechanical work repair the wrong sign from an isolated field-energy gradient, and can an ordinary even-in-current force reduce a supported load with unchanged g?
